name: Regulars
description: Loyalty stamps on Bitcoin Cash: pay a shop and receive its stamps in the same transaction, then redeem them for BCH from a reserve the shop locked up front.

customer.name: Customer
customer.description: Pays the shop and holds its stamps.

earn.name: Pay and earn stamps
earn.description: Pay a shop and take the stamps that payment earns from its issuer contract, in one transaction.

redeem.name: Redeem stamps
redeem.description: Hand stamps to the shop's reward reserve and take the BCH they are worth.

earnTransaction.name: Earned stamps
earnTransaction.description: Paid a shop and earned $(<stamps>) stamps.

issuerInput.name: Stamp issuer
issuerInput.description: The shop's issuer contract output being drawn from.

reserveInput.name: Reward reserve
reserveInput.description: The shop's reward reserve being redeemed against.

issuerOutput.name: Stamp issuer
issuerOutput.description: The issuer contract, recreated with fewer stamps and the protocol fee added.

shopPaymentOutput.name: Payment to shop
shopPaymentOutput.description: What the shop receives for the stamps earned.

stampsOutput.name: Stamps
stampsOutput.description: $(<stamps>) loyalty stamps, redeemable at the shop reserve.

reserveOutput.name: Reward reserve
reserveOutput.description: The reserve, recreated holding the handed-in stamps and less BCH.

issuerLockingScript.name: Stamp issuer contract
issuerLockingScript.description: Releases a shop's stamps only in a transaction that pays the shop for them.

reserveLockingScript.name: Reward reserve contract
reserveLockingScript.description: Pays a fixed amount of BCH for every stamp handed in.

shopLockingScript.name: Shop
shopLockingScript.description: The shop's own address, where payments go.

stampsLockingScript.name: Stamps
stampsLockingScript.description: Loyalty stamps held by the customer's own key.
